body:
Added a short agent working-practice section covering goal and pass/fail checks,
test-first work where cheap, breakage assessment, real-artifact verification,
small ordered PRs, author ownership to green, review-round limits and maintainer
authority. Preserved the existing content and added enforcement-table rows for
the new judgment rules.

Added a documentation contract that reads the real AGENTS.md and checks the
requested practices and section length. It failed before the documentation edit
on base commit e9d68f14dc6e065c077a67729a05122ac1a90740, then passed after it.
These are contributor judgment rules; human review checks execution because a
document test cannot establish contributor conduct.
